## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Guadalajara, Mexico. It starts at 990 Calle Mariano Bárcena.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Michin Guadalajara Aquarium is full of incredible species across five unique ecosystems, each with its distinctive flora and fauna.
>
> The Michin Aquarium also offers an array of activities to dive into, from bouncing on trampolines, and navigating obstacle courses, to engaging in laser tag battles, and even gaming consoles.
>
> And the cherry on top? The chance to interact and feed a selection of the aquarium's inhabitants!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €25.66. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 4 ratings and 1 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
